title: Android 11 Restore is empty (zip and sqlite is correct)
symptom: After upgrading to Android 11 on a Pocophone F2 Pro, restoring a backup created on Android 11 results in empty data (sgv, treatments etc.), while the same backup and APK restore correctly on Android 10. The preferences files import works.
cause: The thread suggests it is due to the new file handling restrictions in Android 11, but no definitive root cause is confirmed.
fix: No confirmed fix. A manifest flag was added in PR #1548 but did not help. A suggestion was made to attempt importing the database file 3-4 times, but it is not confirmed.
evidence_quote: This is the new restriction on file handling in Android 11. As xDrip is most likely not targeting Android 11 any time soon (target is still 23), we could add a flag to the manifest that most likely should still allow to import backups.
